history_rain_strong_threshold: target fit positive P6 75th percentile; descriptive origins, not independent events
response_strong_threshold: target fit positive (future6 maxQ minus Qnow)/fitQ95 75th percentile
physical_response_strong_threshold: target fit positive 3.6(future6 maxQ minus Qnow)/area 75th percentile; common mm/h threshold for all countries; normalized version sensitivity only
reference_policy: every actual target-fit history_cell uses nearest historical physical-feature center; separate low-origin maximum-rise train descriptive reference; foreign ranking always history-only
future_P_policy: offline fit description only; never a forecasting input
raw_policy: target same3fit source events for quality; foreign raw only representative fit source_rows24
sampling_scope: fixed fit pool only; record actual upstream selection_tags; foreign blocks/fragments are not independent complete floods

P_provenance.China: supplied observed P; timezone/accumulation interval semantics unknown
P_provenance.Germany: author gap-filled P series; row-level observed/fill agreement checked only for representative fit windows
P_provenance.Iceland: ERA5-Land reanalysis P, not measured rainfall
